scope: source inspection and executed bounded malformed-image/mode/stale/cap/admission tests; not independent external audit

checks.name_allocation: length checked before bounded name copy; codec validates UTF-8, slash, NUL, dot and dot-dot
checks.tree: directory type before walk; root clamp; checked depth/entry/object caps; no recursive graph traversal
checks.descriptor_authority: private session/token registration; modes and shared offsets belong to descriptions; no identity-based orphan open
checks.last_close: checked reference consumption, no device I/O, no allocator/free path
checks.rename: all fallible semantic admission before binding changes; one working epoch/sole full-volume publication
checks.orphans: capacity before mutation; zero links/mapped backing; explicit unpinned reap; admission rollback and uncertain-I/O quarantine
checks.cold_media: full graph and complete retained closure validation before any writable operation; independent checker traversal
checks.dependencies: no dependency, codec, formatter, geometry or lockfile change

limits: core open/legacy selector APIs trust their caller; VFS authentication/credentials remain outside this engine
global heap OOM retains inherited fail-stop behavior; recoverable allocation failure is UNQUALIFIED
thread-race, DMA fencing, driver durability and native integration are NOT_RUN or UNQUALIFIED
read-only corruption fallback requires future explicit operator recovery; no repair path
NoSpace can defer orphan retirement; no cleaner/progress guarantee
